decision_classes.PUBLIC_TRANSFER_GREEN: Captured-locus mapping/callability and Japanese comparison-panel relationships are broadly reference-invariant; proceed to 6-10-individual focal WGS R1B pilot.
decision_classes.PUBLIC_TRANSFER_AMBER: Public loci are usable for topology/orthology but reference-specific dropout or distance distortion remains; plan focal C. sieboldii reference in parallel with small WGS bias audit.
decision_classes.PUBLIC_TRANSFER_RED: C. sieboldii or the Japanese radiation is strongly and inconsistently represented across congener references; focal C. sieboldii long-read chromosome assembly becomes a prerequisite.
decision_classes.NOT_IDENTIFIABLE: Target definitions or public-data comparability are inadequate; stop public-data expansion and proceed to own-data R1B design.

stop_rule: One bounded captured-locus reference-transfer preflight only; do not turn PRJNA957074 into a new aza3 phylogenomics project.
